lumora.menu.title: Lumora Client
lumora.menu.tagline.opengl: Optimized with Sodium – and servers of every version thanks to ViaFabricPlus.

lumora.hub.title: Lumora Client
lumora.hub.protocol.unavailable: ViaFabricPlus protocol selection is not available.
lumora.toast.title: Lumora benchmark
lumora.hub.modules.hint: Click = on/off · position, size, options and profiles in the HUD editor
lumora.hud.editor.hint: Drag · into the middle = remove · corners = size · Shift = free · Alt = below · double click = options · Ctrl+Z
lumora.module.zoom.description: Zoom in with key %s, distance, transitions, cinematic camera
lumora.hub.card.hint: Click: settings, bar at the bottom: on/off
lumora.module.lumora.description: FPS, CPS, coordinates, keystrokes, ping, clock, speed, server
lumora.module.lumora-info.description: Potion effects, item counter, compass, memory, day, resource packs, combo
lumora.module.lumora-crosshair.descripti: Custom crosshair: shape, size, gap, thickness, colour, outline
lumora.module.lumora-attackindicator.des: Charge of hits, bow, crossbow and trident, item cooldowns, eating, mining: bar, ring, dot, level bar or boss bar
lumora.module.lumora-blockoverlay.descri: Outline of the targeted block: colour, rainbow, thickness, fade in, block info
lumora.module.lumora-widgetdesign.descri: One look for all widgets: background, border, corners, accent, colours, text shadow, format and size
lumora.module.lumora-widgetdesign.settin: Look, colours, RGB, format and size of all widgets
lumora.module.lumora-buttons.description: Buttons in the style Blackout, Hyperium, Liquid, Lunar, PvPClient or Rounded
lumora.module.lumora-browser.description: Own multiplayer and singleplayer menus: search, filter, ping, server and world cards
lumora.module.lumora-connection.descript: Connecting screen with phases and ping, disconnect reason with tips, automatic reconnect
lumora.module.lumora-togglesprint.descri: Toggle sprinting and sneaking with a key press, fly faster and set the momentum while flying
lumora.module.lumora-fullbright.descript: Full brightness in caves and at night (only visible to you)
lumora.module.lumora-statusbars.descript: Hotbar, hearts, armor, hunger, air and experience as separate widgets: move freely, vanilla, compact, bar or number
lumora.module.lumora-elytratrails.descri: Vapour trails or vortices behind the wing tips of gliding players: colour, length, width, from which speed
lumora.module.lumora-chat.description: Timestamps, copy messages, drag size, background, longer history, sound on mention
lumora.module.lumora-tab.description: Ping as a number, move, scale, hide the numbers of or hide the scoreboard
lumora.module.lumora-armor.description: Helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots and held item with durability, every piece moves on its own
lumora-armor.widget.mainhand.description: Item in your hand with durability or count
lumora-armor.widget.helmet.colored.descr: Green above half, yellow from a fifth, red below.
lumora-armor.widget.helmet.hide_empty.de: The piece stays visible in the HUD editor.
lumora-armor.widget.chestplate.colored.d: Green above half, yellow from a fifth, red below.
lumora-armor.widget.chestplate.hide_empt: The piece stays visible in the HUD editor.
lumora-armor.widget.leggings.colored.des: Green above half, yellow from a fifth, red below.
The piece stays visible in the HUD editor.
lumora-armor.widget.boots.colored.descri: Green above half, yellow from a fifth, red below.
lumora-armor.widget.boots.hide_empty.des: The piece stays visible in the HUD editor.
lumora-armor.widget.mainhand.colored.des: Green above half, yellow from a fifth, red below.
The piece stays visible in the HUD editor.
lumora.module.lumora-emojichat.descripti: Emojis in chat messages for :name:, an emoji picker at the chat input and suggestions while typing
lumora.emojichat.setting.inline.descript: Turns :smile: in messages into the emoji, from Minecraft 1.16.5 on. Other players see the text you send.
lumora.emojichat.setting.button: Emoji button at the chat input
lumora.emojichat.setting.button.descript: Opens the emoji picker above the input line on the right; a click inserts the emoji.
lumora.emojichat.setting.suggestions.des: Typing :jo shows matching emojis. Tab completes, the arrow keys choose.
lumora.module.lumora-freelook.descriptio: Look all around your player in third person while holding a key, without changing where you walk
lumora.freelook.setting.mode.description: Hold: freelook only while the key is held. Toggle: one press switches it on, the next one off. Change the key (default: left Alt) here in the settings of the module.
lumora.freelook.setting.view.description: Whether the camera starts behind or in front of your player. Then turn it freely around them with the mouse.
lumora.module.lumora-lightoverlay.descri: Shows the light level of every block from 15 (bright) to 0 (no light) or where hostile mobs can spawn
lumora.lightoverlay.setting.style.descri: Cross, number (the light level of the block, up to 16 blocks around you), tile or marker. Show and hide the overlay with a key you set here in the settings of the module.
lumora.lightoverlay.setting.horizontal.d: How far around you blocks are marked. High values cost more performance.
lumora.lightoverlay.setting.vertical.des: How far above and below you blocks are marked. High values cost more performance.
lumora.lightoverlay.setting.gradient.des: The colour blends from the "now" colour to the "night" colour by the light from the sky, instead of just two colours.
lumora.lightoverlay.setting.color_now.de: Mobs can spawn here at any time, also by day (hardly any light from the sky).
Mobs spawn here only at night; by day there is enough light from the sky.
lumora.lightoverlay.setting.safe_numbers: Shows the light level also on bright blocks where nothing spawns.
Highest block light at which hostile mobs still spawn. 0 since Minecraft 1.18, 7 before.
lumora.lightoverlay.setting.mode.descrip: Light level: the brightness of every block you can stand on, from 15 (fully lit) to 0 (no light). Spawn spots: only the blocks where hostile mobs can spawn, red right now, yellow only at night.
Number (the light level, up to 16 blocks around you), tile or marker in the colour of the light level. Show and hide the overlay with a key you set here in the settings of the module.
lumora.lightoverlay.setting.light_type.d: Block light: only light from torches, lamps and other light sources. Sky light: only light from the sky, as by day. Both: the brighter of the two.
lumora.lightoverlay.setting.color_dark.d: Colour for light level 0, no light.
lumora.lightoverlay.setting.color_medium: Colour for light level 7. The colours blend in between.
lumora.lightoverlay.setting.color_bright: Colour for light level 15, fully lit.
lumora.module.lumora-offhand.description: Show both hands in first person, hide the off hand or hide a shield or a totem
lumora.offhand.setting.offhand_show.desc: Off: the off hand and everything in it is not drawn in first person. Other players still see it.
lumora.offhand.setting.offhand_shield.de: A shield in the off hand is not drawn, also not while blocking. Other items stay visible.
lumora.offhand.setting.offhand_totem.des: A totem of undying in the off hand is not drawn. Other items stay visible.
lumora.offhand.setting.mainhand_shield.d: A shield in the main hand is not drawn, also not while blocking. Other items stay visible.
lumora.offhand.setting.mainhand_totem.de: A totem of undying in the main hand is not drawn. Other items stay visible.
lumora.offhand.setting.both_hands.descri: Also shows the empty off hand, not only the main hand. It sits on the other side of your main hand, which you set in Minecraft under Options › Skin Customization › Main Hand (right or left).
lumora.module.lumora-hiddenarmor.descrip: Make each piece of your armor invisible or see-through; it shows again for a few seconds when you are hit
lumora.animations.sword_block.descriptio: While you hold right-click with a sword, it shows the 1.7 block pose and the swing keeps running (block hitting); also while blocking with a shield in the off hand. Only the drawing: servers since 1.9 do not know sword blocking, so you take no less damage, and other players do not see it.
lumora.animations.recipe_book.descriptio: Legacy (1.7): no recipe book and no button in the inventory, crafting table and furnaces (1.7 had none); the window stays centred. Only in your client: Minecraft keeps remembering whether the book is open as before.
lumora.module.lumora-animations.descript: Classic 1.7 animations, each part on its own: sneaking, hearts, items, bow, food, inventory
lumora.animations.preset.description: Sets all parts to Legacy or Default at once. If you change a part by hand afterwards, the preset switches to Custom.
lumora.animations.swing.description: How the hand swings in first person. Only while the item posture is not Legacy; Legacy brings the original 1.7 swing.
lumora.animations.sneak.description: Camera while sneaking. Legacy (1.7): the camera drops a little at once and rises smoothly when getting up, instead of gliding far down.
lumora.animations.heart.description: How the hearts blink. Legacy (1.7): while you are invulnerable after a hit, not when healing.
lumora.animations.block_build.descriptio: Whether the item dips when placing. Legacy (1.7): never.
lumora.animations.backwards_walking.desc: Legacy (1.7/1.8): the body turns towards the walking direction instead of facing forwards.
lumora.animations.head_rotation.descript: Legacy (1.7/1.8): the head turns up to 75° from the body instead of at most 50°.
lumora.animations.sword.description: Pose while blocking with a sword. Legacy (1.7): block pose, the swing keeps running (block hitting).
lumora.animations.posture.description: How the item is held in first person. Legacy (1.7): with the original 1.7 swing.
lumora.animations.bow.description: Holding and drawing the bow in first person.
lumora.animations.food.description: Eating and drinking animation in first person.
lumora.animations.fishing_rod.descriptio: How the fishing rod is held. 1.7: turned by 180°.
lumora.animations.item_equip.description: Dip when switching. Legacy (1.7): only for another slot or item, not with the attack cooldown.
lumora.animations.posture_third.descript: How players hold items in third person. Legacy (1.7): placement at the arm as in 1.7, the blocking arm not turned.
lumora.animations.creative_layout.descri: Legacy (1.8): the creative inventory tabs as in 1.8 (1.7 had the same).
lumora.hiddenarmor.setting.opacity.descr: How visible this piece of armor is: 0 % invisible, 100 % as usual. The enchantment glint only shows at 100 %. Only your view changes, other players still see the armor.
On: moving one slider moves the other three as well.
lumora.hiddenarmor.setting.applies_to.de: Only your own armor or that of every player. Mobs and armor stands always stay unchanged.
lumora.hiddenarmor.setting.show_on_hit.d: When a player is hit, their armor is fully visible again for the time set below.
lumora.hiddenarmor.setting.hit_seconds.d: How long the armor stays visible after the last hit.
lumora.hiddenarmor.setting.fade.descript: After that time the armor slowly turns see-through again instead of vanishing at once.
lumora.hud.speed.label: Speed
lumora.hub.zoom.hint: Key %s (change under Controls) · scroll while zooming, up to 50×
lumora.hub.addons.none: No addons installed. Put addon jars into the addon folder.
lumora.hub.addons.hint: Addons: jars in the addon folder or Fabric mods · ⚙ = settings and keys
lumora.widget.failed.title: Widget switched off (error)
lumora.hud.potions.description: Active potion and status effects with level and remaining time
lumora-info.widget.potions.compact: Compact (one line per effect, no picture)
lumora.hud.helditem.description: Name of the held item after switching, like Minecraft shows it above the hotbar: in Java style or in Pocket style with a border and enchantments
lumora.hud.inventory.description: Your inventory as a HUD while you hold the hotkey (default X, changeable in the widget's settings); also on/off, briefly or always if you like; in the look of Minecraft's inventory or of the Lumora widgets
lumora.hud.inventory.title: Inventory
lumora-info.widget.inventory.title: Title "Inventory"
lumora.hud.items.description: Arrows in your inventory and how many of the held item you have left
lumora.hud.compass.description: Directions as a strip at the top of the screen
lumora.hud.memory.label: RAM
lumora.hud.day.description: Day of the world and in-game time
lumora.hud.day.label: Day
lumora.hud.combo.description: Hits in a row without being hit
lumora.hud.combo.label: Combo
lumora.hud.togglesprint.description: Shows whether sprint or sneak is toggled
lumora.extras.togglesprint.fly_speed.des: How much faster you fly in creative and spectator mode, sideways as well as up and down. 1x is normal. Only where you are allowed to fly; some servers treat fast flying as cheating or pull you back.
How far you keep gliding while flying after letting go of the movement keys. 100 % is normal, 0 % stops at once.
lumora.extras.crosshair.scale.descriptio: Size of the preset or custom crosshair (1 = as large as the normal crosshair)
lumora.extras.attackindicator.style.desc: The XP bar and boss bar styles sit on the experience bar or at the top of the screen; position and size do not apply then.
lumora.extras.attackindicator.hide_when_: Like Minecraft: the indicator disappears as soon as your hit does full damage again.
lumora.extras.attackindicator.show_on_ta: Show when aiming at a mob
Shows the full indicator while you aim at a mob and can hit.
Ender pearls, chorus fruit, wind charges, goat horns and your shield after an axe hit: when they are ready again.
lumora.extras.attackindicator.charging.d: How far your bow is drawn, your crossbow loaded or your trident pulled back.
lumora.extras.attackindicator.sound_read: Sound when the attack is ready
From 1.9: a short sound as soon as your hit does full damage again.
lumora.zoom.key.description: The key that zooms the camera (the same as in Minecraft's controls).
lumora.zoom.hold.description: On: the zoom is active as long as the zoom key is pressed. Off: the key switches the zoom on and off.
lumora.zoom.scroll.description: Changes the zoom distance with the scroll wheel while you zoom.
lumora.zoom.hand.description: Shows your hand and the held item while zooming.
lumora.zoom.distance.description: How far the zoom goes. The larger the number, the closer.
lumora.zoom.sensitivity.description: The mouse moves the camera slower while zoomed, so aiming stays steady.
lumora.zoom.vignette.description: A dark border around the screen while you zoom.
lumora.zoom.cinema_bars.description: Black bars slide in at the top and bottom of the screen while you zoom.
lumora.zoom.bar_height.description: The height of each bar in percent of the screen height, 5 to 25.
lumora.zoom.hide_hud.description: Hides the HUD and the chat like F1 while you zoom.
lumora.zoom.cinematic.description: Puts the camera into cinematic mode while zooming.
lumora.zoom.cinematic_transition.descrip: The cinematic camera is only on while the zoom transition runs, then you steer normally again.
lumora.zoom.smooth.description: Smoothly animates the camera when zooming in and out.
lumora.zoom.in_ease.description: How the camera moves when zooming in. You can choose from different modes.
lumora.zoom.in_ms.description: The duration of the zoom-in transition.
lumora.zoom.out_ease.description: How the camera moves when zooming out. You can choose from different modes.
lumora.zoom.out_ms.description: The duration of the zoom-out transition.
lumora.extras.elytratrails.style.descrip: Vapor trails: straight lines behind the wing tips. Vortices: counter-rotating spirals that widen behind you.
lumora.extras.elytratrails.min_speed.des: Trails only appear from this speed. Normal gliding is about 10 to 30 blocks per second.
lumora.extras.elytratrails.turn_boost.de: In turns and banks the trails get wider and stronger; flying straight they stay thin.
lumora.extras.elytratrails.speed_width.d: The faster you glide, the wider the trails.
lumora.extras.elytratrails.glow.descript: The trails shine with a bright halo instead of being half transparent. Strongest at night.
lumora-statusbars.widget.hotbar.descript: The hotbar with items, selection and offhand
lumora-statusbars.widget.hotbar.offhand_: Off: the offhand slot stays empty while a shield or totem is in it.
lumora-statusbars.widget.armor.auto_hide: Like Minecraft: without armor points the bar is not shown.
lumora-statusbars.widget.air.auto_hide.d: Like Minecraft: the bubbles only show under water or while the air is not full.
lumora.extras.chat.history.description: How many messages you can scroll back (Minecraft: 100).
lumora.extras.chat.custom_size.descripti: Width and height of the chat instead of Minecraft's setting. Also by dragging the edges of the open chat.
lumora.extras.chat.height_closed.descrip: Height in game while the chat is not open. Never higher than the open chat.
lumora.extras.chat.resize.description: Drag any edge or corner of a chat window in the open chat to make it wider, narrower, higher or lower.
lumora.extras.chat.fade.description: Off: messages stay visible in the closed chat until new ones push them up.
lumora.extras.chat.menu.description: In the open chat, click "⋯" next to a message or right-click it: copy the message, the name or a link, reply privately.
lumora.extras.chat.mention_sound.descrip: A sound when someone writes your name (not for your own messages).
lumora.extras.chat.keep_on_leave.descrip: The chat stays when you leave a world or server, so you can still read it in the next one. F3+D still clears it.
lumora.extras.chat.windows.description: Lumora draws the chat: tabs above it (“+” for a new tab, “≡” for all tabs and windows), windows of their own anywhere on the screen. Hold the left mouse button on the messages and drag to scroll, drag the bar to move a window and any edge to resize it. Off: Minecraft's chat.
lumora.extras.chat.heads.description: The head of the player in front of their messages (players of the tab list).
lumora.extras.chat.tabs.to_window: Move to a window of its own
lumora.extras.chat.tabs.title: What should the tab collect?
lumora.extras.chat.tabs.subtitle: Give the messages you care about a place of their own.
lumora.extras.chat.tabs.from_message.hin: What the message you clicked has.
lumora.extras.chat.tabs.suggestions.none: Nothing came up often enough yet.
lumora.extras.chat.tabs.rule.rank.choose: Messages with a rank before the name
lumora.extras.chat.tabs.rule.all.desc: Every message, a second view of the chat.
lumora.extras.chat.tabs.keep: Also keep them in the main chat
lumora.extras.chat.tabs.keep.desc: When off, matching messages move here and leave the main chat.
lumora.extras.chat.tabs.highlight.desc: With this color behind the message.
lumora.extras.chat.tabs.name: Name
lumora.extras.chat.tabs.where.here.desc: Next to the other tabs of this chat window.
lumora.extras.chat.tabs.where.new.desc: A window of its own you can move anywhere on the screen.
lumora.extras.chat.tabs.where.main.desc: Next to the other tabs of the main chat.
lumora.extras.chat.tabs.later: You can change all of it later with the pencil on the tab.
lumora.extras.tab.ping_numbers: Ping as a number in the tab list
lumora.hud.blockinfo.description: Name and id of the targeted block
lumora.extras.browser.multiplayer: Lumora server list instead of the multiplayer menu
lumora.extras.browser.singleplayer: Lumora world list instead of the singleplayer menu
lumora.extras.browser.gamemodes.descript: Known servers show their game modes as coloured tags in the Lumora server list, only those for your Minecraft version. They come from the same Lumora mapping (LumoraClient/Multiplayer-Mapping) as banners and names.
lumora.extras.browser.mappings.descripti: Known servers get their banner, icon, name and categories in the Lumora server list from the Lumora repository LumoraClient/Multiplayer-Mapping (GPL-3.0, built from NoRiskClient/nrc-server-mappings and LabyMod/server-media). The list is loaded from GitHub at most every 12 hours, pictures only for servers in your list; everything is cached.
lumora.extras.connection.screens: Lumora screens when connecting and disconnecting
lumora.extras.connection.world_screen: Lumora loading screen when entering a world
lumora.module.lumora-performance.descrip: Entity culling, faster name tags, menus and startup; every optimization can be switched on its own
lumora.performance.clouds.description: The cloud geometry is not rebuilt when only the cloud colour changed
lumora.performance.entity_culling.descri: Entities and block entities completely hidden behind opaque blocks are not drawn
lumora.performance.frame.description: Rounded panels, borders and buttons reuse their corner shapes from frame to frame
lumora.performance.note.clouds_vanilla: not needed: this Minecraft version already rebuilds the clouds only when needed
lumora.performance.rendering.description: Name tags and Lumora texts above players without rebuilding them every frame
lumora.performance.smart_hud.description: HUD widgets and Lumora menus only measure texts and rebuild content when it changed
lumora.performance.startup.description: The Lumora Loader loads game classes with less work (takes effect on the next start)
lumora.performance.status.culling: Last culling pass: %s of %s hidden, %s ms
lumora.performance.status.title: Performance
lumora.performance.unsupported: not supported in this Minecraft version
lumora.module.lumora-cosmetics.descripti: Wings, capes, hats, accessories, effects and companions on your player, emotes with menu and wheel (only you see them)
lumora.cosmetics.setting.show_own.descri: Shows the cosmetics you wear on your player. Other players do not see them in this version.
lumora.cosmetics.setting.animate.descrip: Wings flap, capes wave, companions float. Off: cosmetics stand still.
lumora.cosmetics.setting.stop_on_move.de: Whole-body emotes (dancing, sitting …) end when you walk or jump. Waving and clapping go on while walking.
lumora.cosmetics.setting.emote_camera.de: Switches to third person while an emote plays and back afterwards.
lumora.cosmetics.setting.wheel_slots.des: How many emotes the wheel shows (4 to 10). Assign them in the emote menu.
lumora.cosmetics.title: Lumora Cosmetics
lumora.cosmetics.empty_favorites: No favorites yet: right click or the star on a card.
lumora.cosmetics.select_hint: Click a cosmetic to try it on in the preview. Several together make a combination. Right click: favorite.
lumora.cosmetics.select_emote_hint: Click an emote to see it in the preview. Right click: favorite.
lumora.cosmetics.preview.no_world: The preview with your player is available in a world.
lumora.cosmetics.wheel.title: Emote wheel
lumora.cosmetics.wheel.hint_select: Choose an emote, then click a slot. Right click empties a slot.
lumora.cosmetics.wheel.help: Click: play · 1–0: slot · Right click: close
lumora.cosmetics.item.angel_wings.descri: White feathered wings that flap gently and beat hard when you jump.
lumora.cosmetics.item.dragon_wings.descr: Purple scaled wings with membranes, spread wide while gliding.
lumora.cosmetics.item.lumora_cape.descri: A blue cape with a golden star that waves as you run.
lumora.cosmetics.item.starry_cape.descri: A night blue cape full of stars.
lumora.cosmetics.item.top_hat.descriptio: A black top hat with a red band.
lumora.cosmetics.item.halo.description: A glowing ring floating above your head, slowly turning.
lumora.cosmetics.item.wizard_hat.descrip: A pointed hat with stars; the tip sways.
lumora.cosmetics.item.ninja_mask.descrip: A cloth over mouth and nose; the ends flutter in the wind.
lumora.cosmetics.item.backpack.descripti: A leather backpack with a pocket and straps.
lumora.cosmetics.item.shoulder_fox.descr: A little fox on your shoulder wagging its tail.
lumora.cosmetics.item.spirit_orb.descrip: A glowing orb floating next to you.
lumora.cosmetics.item.flame_aura.descrip: Two rings of flames circle around your feet.
lumora.cosmetics.item.sparkle_trail.desc: Sparks rise behind you while you run.
lumora.cosmetics.emote.groove.descriptio: Arms up and down, bouncing to the beat.
lumora.cosmetics.emote.sit.description: Sit on the ground until you move.
lumora.cosmetics.emote.lay_down.descript: Lie on your back until you move.
lumora.cosmetics.emote.cry.description: Hands in front of the face, sobbing.
lumora.cosmetics.emote.celebrate.descrip: Both arms up and two jumps.
lumora.cosmetics.emote.air_guitar.descri: A solo on the invisible guitar.
